create_cyclist_instance: create a Cyclist instance with height, weight, power, event, start position, and gender parameters
set_pace_distance: set a cyclist pace by power output and calculate the distance traveled in the time step
follow_cyclist_distance: follow another cyclist by distance to compute required power and update velocity
update_cyclist_energy: update a cyclist total energy based on gender, weight, and mean maximum power values
reset_cyclist_state: reset a cyclist remaining energy, position, fatigue level, and velocity to initial values
